'''Patrick Tabeling''' is a French [[physicist]], [[microfluidics]] pioneer in France, researcher at the [[École supérieure de physique et de chimie industrielles de la ville de Paris]] (ESPCI ParisTech). He has published more than 200 articles in prestigious peer-reviewed journals and his work has been cited more than 14000 times. 
He has been the director of the [[Institut Pierre-Gilles de Gennes|Pierre Gilles de Gennes Institute for Microfluidics]] (IPGG), an interdisciplinary research institution in Paris which regroups more than 300 expert researchers.

==Biography==
Graduated from the [[École supérieure d'électricité]] (1974 promotion), Patrick Tabeling was a CNRS (Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique) researcher at the [[statistical physics]] laboratory of the [[École normale supérieure (rue d'Ulm — Paris)|École normale supérieure de la rue d'Ulm]] (ENS Ulm) from 1985 to 2001. In 2001, he moved to the [[École supérieure de physique et de chimie industrielles de la ville de Paris]] (ESPCI ParisTech) where he created the group [[Microfluidics]], [[Microelectromechanical systems]] (MEMS) and [[Nanoelectromechanical system|nanostructure]]s<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mmn.espci.fr/ |title=Home |website=mmn.espci.fr}}</ref> laboratory. He was charged by the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] to coordinate the activity of research laboratories in microfluidics as a chairman of the French microfluidic network.<ref>[http://www.laas.fr/Microfluidique/ Réseau microfluidique] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091223080707/http://www.laas.fr/Microfluidique/ |date=2009-12-23 }}</ref>

Patrick Tabeling has published "Introduction to Microfluidics" (Oxford University Press, 2005), was divisional editor of '' [[Physical Review Letters]]'', associated Editor of "Physics of Fluids". He is cofounder of IPGG (Institut Pierre Gilles de Gennes) and acted as director  ([[Institut Pierre-Gilles de Gennes]]) from 2011 to 2018. He  published more than 200 papers,  was elected to Academia Europaea (2010). He is the cofounder of MicroFactory (2014) and Minos Biosciences (2018).

==Works==
Patrick Tabeling's laboratory develops microfluidic applications <ref>[http://www.larecherche.fr/content/recherche/article?id=9235 Lab on chip] {{webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20120905222310/http://www.larecherche.fr/content/recherche/article?id=9235 |date=2012-09-05 }}</ref> with industrial <ref>[http://www.opticsvalley.org/images_webzine/ART_1280/lumiere_22.pdf Industrial collaborations] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080509155650/http://www.opticsvalley.org/images_webzine/ART_1280/lumiere_22.pdf |date=2008-05-09 }}</ref> and research laboratories of [[biology]] and [[analytical Chemistry]] of ESPCI and is concerned with fundamental topics such as wall slippage, self organization, droplet dynamics or stem cells.
